## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R33

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#9304 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R33.
Clause-②: yes

### ⛔ The triage comment on this card is **BINDING** — read it in full first (rule 38)
It confirms the scope with a **repo-wide** grep, adopts the card's methodological rule as a hard acceptance condition, and adds **one site the card did not name** that you will hit while editing. Where it differs from anything below, it wins.

### ⭐ Premise re-verified at this seat before dispatch (rule 52)
Read on `origin/main` just now — both bindings live, and the whole of `packages/` returns exactly these two:

```
packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx:99   const ctx = useRecordContext() as any;
packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx:94                const record = useRecordContext() as any;
```

⭐ Triage ran that grep over **all of `packages/`**, not just the two packages the card names — so "two" is a **scope**, not a sample.

### ⭐ Why this is not a leftover — the point of the card
objectui#9197 (PR objectui#9289) landed the retype (`dataSource?: DataSource`, with `dataSource?: string` at 0 hits). But `record-activity.tsx` has **exactly one** `const ctx` binding, at `:99`, and it is already `any` — so the narrower `as any` that PR removed one scope below changed **nothing about the type**.

⇒ ⭐ **"cast-free at the read site" is not "typed".** A file that looks repaired is not. ⚠️ Stated fairly, and triage concurred: the delivering seat's claim was about **read sites** and that claim is **true** — this card is about the **binding**, which that scan was not keyed on. ⛔ Not an accusation of a bad delivery; a **blind spot in how a scan was keyed**.

### ⭐⭐ The methodological rule is an acceptance condition, not advice
> **Key any scan on the BINDING, not on the identifier.**

It comes with measured evidence: a cast list keyed on the name `ctx` produced a count that **matched the real one by coincidence while overlapping on only six of eleven**. ⇒ **an equal total is not an equal set.** Read that once before you scan.

### The acceptance
- Remove both `useRecordContext() as any` bindings and let the declaration do the typing.
- ⭐ **Re-run the audit; ⛔ do not trust this card's line numbers.** The discriminant is *"is every member read off this binding declared on `RecordContextValue`?"* — ⛔ not the five line numbers below, which drift. (Triage measured them all declared: `ctx?.objectName`, `ctx?.data?.id ?? ctx?.data?._id ?? ctx?.recordId`, `ctx?.dataSource`, `record?.objectName`, `record?.recordId`.)
- ⚠️ **The site the card did not name**, and you will hit it:
  ```
  LineItemsPanel.tsx:98   schema.parentId || schema.recordId || (record?.recordId as string | undefined)
  ```
  An inner cast layered on a binding that is **already `any`** — today it does nothing. Once the outer cast is gone it becomes either **pure redundancy** or **a real type mismatch to handle**. ⛔ Do not just delete it silently, and ⛔ **do not put the outer cast back because this one goes red.** Say in the PR which of the two it turned out to be.
- ⭐ **Ablation leg — and on this card it is NOT a formality.** Put either `as any` back; the pin must redden. ⚠️ A pure cast-removal change makes it very easy to write a pin that **stays green whether or not the cast is there** — which is precisely the disease this card describes. If your ablation does not redden, you have written that pin.

### ⛔ Boundary
⛔ **Do not touch the five `packages/fields` sites** — `fields/src/index.tsx:133`, `CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx:156`, `FilterConditionField.tsx:432`, `ObjectRefField.tsx:40`, `RecipientPickerField.tsx:62`. They read **`SchemaRendererContext`**, a different context with a different declaration, and they are **objectui#7912's** face.

### ⚠️ Sequencing
objectui#7912 is in flight (PR objectui#9310, currently **held** on objectui#9311) retyping `SchemaRendererContextType.dataSource` and the provider prop. Triage reviewed the boundary claim and agreed: **different context, different declaration, disjoint file faces** ⇒ ⛔ **no `Blocked-by:`**. But run the in-flight check once and confirm the faces really are disjoint rather than assuming it.

### Standing constraints for this round
- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7).
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- **Changeset required.** 41 packages in ONE `fixed` group ⇒ `major` unavailable. ⚠️ This is a **type-side** change with ⛔ no runtime effect (the value was always complete at runtime — that is objectui#9197's own argument). Let the level follow that measurement.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script matching `no-major`**; the file runs inside **`changeset:check`**. A `254 Command not found` on another spelling is **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️ **A package-scoped run is not the blast radius** (objectui#9273).
- ⚠️⚠️ **A declared narrowing of your verification union can still be the load-bearing one.** This lane just paid for it: a seat excluded `@object-ui/site` as "a docs app", and `apps/site` both declares `type-check` **and** depends on the package under change — CI went red exactly there. ⭐ Before trusting any exclusion, do a **membership read** of the dependent set plus a look at the excluded package's own `scripts`.
- ⚠️ **Install/build first.** A missing `node_modules` makes every `require.resolve` fail identically — **instrument failure, not a negative answer**. Read verdicts from the verify-lock wrapper's VERDICT line, never a bare `$?`.
- ⚠️ **Carrier rule (directional):** hang `needs:contract-review` on **both** limbs in one stroke. ⛔ **Never clear either limb**; clearing is the PM's. (REST label POST needs `Content-Type: application/json`, else **415** — ⛔ not a permission failure.)
- ⚠️ **In flight:** objectui#9274 (`app-shell`, p1) · objectui#9294 (`plugin-grid`, possibly `packages/fields`) · PR objectui#9310 (held).
- ⛔ No model identifier in any pushed artifact; ⛔ don't copy a neighbouring commit's trailer — use the model-free form. ⛔ Card relations belong in the **PR body**, not the commit message.

### ⭐ The two instrument standards this seat holds
1. **Write the pin BEFORE the code** — the "unmodified" arm is then the real base tree.
2. **Every control must be able to fire.** ⭐ On a type-only card the characteristic dead instrument is a harness that **degrades the types to `any`**, which makes every row pass while measuring nothing. Carry controls proving resolution is real — a misspelled member must be refused.
